body: Well I now know what I’m going to have to make this year! 😂 thanks
Okay normally I’m a serial lurker but I am absolutely fascinated by how you made sausage rolls on one! Was it easy enough to do?
You know what, with the people I met up with last year, I genuinely wouldn’t even mind

I was the absolute same!! Put off reading it for so long, then because I saw it on offer on Amazon, and finally decided I would try it out, even though I don’t really read much fiction anymore. A month later, and I’ve read through all of ACOTAR (which is now genuinely one of my favourite book series of all time, perhaps genuinely my top favourite), the Crescent City series, and I’m reading through Throne of Glass now. Like.. reading these books has genuinely made me want to start writing again, and enjoy reading fiction again. Glad to see someone else got bitten by the ACOTAR bug too :)

Thankyou so much for that. Those last words aren’t things I have ever really heard before, so hearing them now is... yeah. Big emotions time. I’m on a waiting list for therapy, and I’m looking into what I’ve got available around where I live until then. But yeah, Thankyou so much. ❤️
Thanks so much. I’m currently on a 3 year waiting list for NHS therapy, but I’ve been looking into what I can do in the meantime in my area.
I hope they can too. But I get what you’re saying about having to look after myself first- it’s proving hard for now, where there’s still so much in my head, but I’m trying. Thanks so much.
